_comment: Copy to data/raw/redactions.json (git-ignored) and tune. Rectangles are in OUTPUT (post-downscale) pixel space — open a produced frame in data/public/frames/, read pixel coords, adjust, re-run `npm run dataset:prepare -- --force`. Keyed by SOURCE basename (no extension); every frame derived from that source gets the list. mode: "blur" (default) or "fill" (solid gray — use for windows / anything that could geolocate). Goal: no vendor phone/email, QR code, notice text, or outdoor view legible; machine doors, displays and indicator lights stay sharp.

IMG_1234.note: service-sticker + QR band above the displays
